en: I'm afraid Morty isn't here. He's gone to the Burned Tower, the one in the city's north-west.
He says something stirs there. Come back when he's returned, young one.
Good of you to come. I've trained here all my life to see what others cannot.
They say a rainbow Pokémon will appear before the trainer it chooses. I'd like to know if that's you. Let's see!
I'm not good enough yet... All right. You've earned this. The Fog Badge is yours.
{player} received the Fog Badge from Morty!
With the Fog Badge, Pokémon up to level fifty will obey you, and you can use Surf outside of battle.
Take this too. It's a move that suits a Ghost Pokémon well.
TM30 is Shadow Ball. It may lower the foe's Special Defense. A fine move for any trainer who walks among ghosts.
I see now. The legend is about the bond between a trainer and Pokémon. I'll keep training until I understand it.
Yo, challenger! Morty's Ghost types can't be touched by Normal or Fighting moves. Dark moves work wonders!
And watch your feet. This floor is full of holes you can't see. Stick to the path!
You saw your way across that floor and beat Morty! Your eyes are sharper than mine, champ.
